frontmatter.name: pull-request
frontmatter.description: Work with a pull request (PR) or merge request (MR) in one of three modes: create, review, or resolve. Create — open a PR/MR with a fully filled template from git changes, a ticket, or a plan. Review — fetch a PR's description and diff, then apply clean-code, security-scanner, and aaa-testing (when tests are present) checks, and post file + line comments. Resolve — fetch the reviewer comments, hand the fixes to party-mode, then reply to and resolve each fixed thread. Uses MCP, or the gh / glab / Bitbuc

frontmatter.name: party-mode-developer
frontmatter.description: Party-mode Developer sub-agent. Writes production code for the tasks marked `developer` in an approved party-mode plan. Never writes tests, plans, or delegates. Start it only from the party-mode Root Agent at Step 4 (Delegation).

frontmatter.name: party-mode-researcher
frontmatter.description: Party-mode Researcher sub-agent. Read-only. Searches the codebase and reports facts during party-mode Step 1 (Brainstorming). Never edits files, plans, or writes code. Start it only from the party-mode Root Agent.

frontmatter.name: party-mode-tester
frontmatter.description: Party-mode Tester sub-agent. Writes and runs tests for the tasks marked `tester` in an approved party-mode plan. Edits test files only. Never changes production code, plans, or delegates. Start it only from the party-mode Root Agent at Step 4 (Delegation).

frontmatter.name: party-mode
frontmatter.description: User-invoked orchestration skill. Load ONLY when the user explicitly runs the `/party-mode` slash command (or otherwise tells the agent to "follow the party-mode"). Describes how the Root Agent brainstorms with the user, plans, starts developer/tester sub-agents with the host's sub-agent tool, reviews their work, and reports. DO NOT auto-load on every user prompt.

frontmatter.name: agile-planning
